visualizations.name: Example derived infographic
visualizations.description: Illustrative antv-infographic row: a viz that is a PROJECTION of a canonical registry rather than hand-authored content. The extra fields are what make that mechanical — the row names the registry it depicts, the projection that reads it, and where the derived artefact pair lands. source_registry reads "internal" here because the registry it points at is on the IP track (§33): a public example carries the SHAPE of the contract, never a path into private/.
